facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. Hung Nhi Son Pagoda sits quietly in Phu Quoc while most visitors never leave the beach strip. Dragon columns, incense smoke, hand-painted murals. Zero crowds. The kind of place locals visit on weekday mornings without telling anyone. If you want one hour of actual stillness on this island, this is it. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Incense rising, murals painted floor to ceiling, and not a tour group in sight. Hung Nhi Son Pagoda is the Phu Quoc stop nobody puts on the itinerary. Worth every minute.
